name: com.drinksystem
description: Networked black and gold bar drink station for VRChat worlds (PC + Quest): drink cards with pour buttons, cups that lock into place, froth / strength / spirit / fruit / straw options, a cup customizer kiosk, glowing logo glasses, pour / fizz / slurp sounds, drinking with optional screen effects and cup respawn. Lightweight manual sync. One-click builder: Tools > Drink System > Build Drink Machine In Scene.
